title: helperTemplates
responsibility: Reads runtime template expressions with Svelte block scope preserved for helper reuse analysis.

inputs.name: helperTemplates.code
inputs.description: Svelte component source passed to the Svelte parser and script scanner. Plain markup and string literals are not emitted as template helper uses; parsed template expressions are wrapped for analysis.

outputs.name: helperTemplates
outputs.description: The script code and generated wrapper functions for positioned Svelte template expressions, joined with newline characters. Each wrapper uses bindings from block context and parameters as local parameters, preserving scope during helper reuse analysis.

errors.name: Svelte parser error
errors.description: An exception from parse(code, { modern: true }) propagates when the Svelte source cannot be parsed; this function does not catch or transform it.
